description: This file defines the CounterGrain class, which is an Orleans grain implementing ICounterGrain. It manages a collection of grains with counters, provides methods to retrieve timing info, total counter value, tracking grains, and wait time for reporting based on provided options.

classes.name: CounterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that tracks other grains with counters and provides reporting functionalities.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the grain's run as specified in the reporting options.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Aggregates and returns the total counter value from all tracked grains for a given counter name.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Adds a grain with counters to the tracked list.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Calculates and returns the remaining time until the next report based on the reporting options.
